summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced the cancellation of planned strikes against Iran following a reported agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. However, Iranian sources have denied any such agreement, while a U.S. strike reportedly killed three people on Qeshm Island. Israel remains on high alert amid ongoing operations in Gaza and Southern Lebanon.
key_points: President Donald Trump announced the cancellation of planned strikes against Iran, citing a request from Iran and other Middle Eastern nations (Source: @inon_yttach/9778).
Iranian Foreign Minister Aragchi reportedly agreed to a Qatari-U.S. compromise to reopen the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6016).
A source close to the Iranian nuclear negotiation team denied any agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @naya_foriraq/86722).
A U.S. strike using a 2,000-pound Mark 84 bomb hit a home on Qeshm Island, killing two parents and a two-year-old child (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6004).
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman expressed concern to Donald Trump regarding potential strong U.S. strikes against Iran (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382531).
The IDF killed Hamas Nukhba Force cell head Salem Jamal Abd al-Rahman Abu Labad in southern Gaza and commander Muhammad Abd al-Nasser Muhammad Khatib in central Gaza (Source: @manniefabian/58909).
An IDF combat officer was moderately wounded during an operation in southern Lebanon where several Hezbollah terrorists were eliminated in the Ali Tahar ridge area (Source: @inon_yttach/9775).
The LNG tanker GasLog Shanghai reported a projectile hit in its engine room, causing a fire and loss of power near the coast of Oman (Source: @naya_foriraq/86705).

sections.executive_summary: President Donald Trump has announced the cancellation of planned strikes against Iran, contingent on a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end Iran's nuclear threat. This follows reports of a Qatari-U.S. compromise, though Iranian officials have explicitly denied that any such agreement exists. Meanwhile, kinetic activity continues with U.S. strikes in Qeshm and Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon.

points: A U.S. strike on Qeshm Island overnight Thursday utilized a 2,000-pound Mark 84 bomb, resulting in the deaths of two parents and a two-year-old child (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6004).
Acting Defense Minister Brigadier General Seyyed Majid Ibn Al-Reza stated that Iran considers all enemy threats real and is using them to raise preparedness and deterrence (Source: @PressTV/201270).
A source close to the nuclear negotiation team claimed the Strait of Hormuz remains closed to ships unless they follow the declared path with IRGC Navy permission (Source: @naya_foriraq/86722).
Reports indicate Foreign Minister Aragchi agreed to a Qatari-U.S. compromise to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, which allegedly prompted the cancellation of U.S. strikes (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6016).
Israel has been placed on the highest state of alert, with senior political and security officials conducting consultations over the weekend (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6002).
Former PM Naftali Bennett claimed Qatar funded the Nukhba forces and Al Jazeera reporters who entered on October 7, stating Qatar is more dangerous than Iran (Source: @yediotnews25/133484).

The IDF reported the elimination of Hamas Nukhba cell head Salem Jamal Abd al-Rahman Abu Labad in southern Gaza and commander Muhammad Abd al-Nasser Muhammad Khatib in central Gaza (Source: @manniefabian/58909).
The IDF reported that several Hezbollah terrorists were eliminated in the Ali Tahar ridge area during an operation in southern Lebanon (Source: @inon_yttach/9775).

The IDF conducted precise aerial strikes in southern and central Gaza to eliminate Hamas operatives Salem Jamal Abd al-Rahman Abu Labad and Muhammad Abd al-Nasser Muhammad Khatib (Source: @manniefabian/58909).
Reports from the Israeli Broadcasting Authority suggest Hamas has begun distributing rifles to its elements in the Gaza Strip under the guise of personal weapons (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382534).
An IDF combat officer was moderately wounded during operational activity in southern Lebanon in the Ali Tahar ridge area (Source: @idf_telegram/24801).
IDF forces identified and eliminated several Hezbollah terrorists in the Ali Tahar ridge security zone to remove threats to troops (Source: @inon_yttach/9775).
Explosions were reported in Erbil, Iraq (Source: @shin_persian/8777).
An official Jordanian source informed Al Arabiya that Jordan delivered a message to Iraq regarding the targeting of Iranian-backed militias (Source: @New_security8200/203144).
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke with Donald Trump on Saturday to express concern over strong U.S. strikes against Iran (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382531).
The LNG tanker GasLog Shanghai suffered a projectile hit in its engine room, causing a fire and total loss of power while exiting the Strait of Hormuz near Oman (Source: @naya_foriraq/86705).

key_developments: President Trump announced the cancellation of planned strikes against Iran following a reported deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @inon_yttach/9778).
A U.S. strike on Qeshm Island using a 2,000-pound Mark 84 bomb killed three people, including a child (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6004).
Iranian officials denied any agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, stating it remains closed to unauthorized traffic (Source: @naya_foriraq/86722).
The LNG tanker GasLog Shanghai was hit by a projectile in its engine room near the coast of Oman (Source: @naya_foriraq/86705).
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman urged Donald Trump to avoid extensive strikes against Iran to reduce tensions (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78525).
The IDF eliminated Hamas Nukhba cell head Salem Jamal Abd al-Rahman Abu Labad and commander Muhammad Abd al-Nasser Muhammad Khatib (Source: @manniefabian/58909).
An IDF combat officer was moderately wounded during an operation against Hezbollah in the Ali Tahar ridge in southern Lebanon (Source: @inon_yttach/9775).
sections.threat_assessment: The situation remains highly volatile due to conflicting reports regarding a diplomatic deal between the U.S. and Iran. While President Trump claims a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz has halted strikes, Iranian sources deny this, and kinetic actions—such as the Qeshm Island strike and the attack on the GasLog Shanghai—indicate ongoing hostilities. The risk of rapid escalation remains high if diplomatic efforts fail or if Iran retaliates for the Qeshm strike.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia is actively attempting to mitigate escalation, with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman urging the U.S. to avoid strikes that could destabilize the region. Jordan is coordinating with Iraq regarding Iranian-backed militias. Meanwhile, Israel remains on the highest alert, continuing targeted strikes against Hamas and Hezbollah leadership.
sections.intelligence_notes: There is a significant discrepancy between U.S. public statements and Iranian official denials regarding the status of the Strait of Hormuz. The use of a 2,000-pound Mark 84 bomb on Qeshm Island suggests a high-intensity U.S. operational capability is active. The targeting of Nukhba Force leadership in Gaza indicates a continued Israeli focus on degrading Hamas's elite operational cells.
